facts.verifyQuery: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS vendas, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS estornos, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.id), 3) AS razao FROM cashiers c JOIN transactions t ON t.cashier_id = c.id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.cashier_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING vendas >= 100 ORDER BY razao DESC
SELECT cashier_id, COUNT(*), MIN(amount), MAX(amount), SUM(amount) FROM refunds WHERE approved_by IS NULL GROUP BY cashier_id
SELECT approved_by, COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE cashier_id = 4 GROUP BY approved_by
SELECT t.payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN transactions t ON t.id = r.transaction_id WHERE r.cashier_id = 4 GROUP BY t.payment_method
SELECT strftime('%H', refunded_at) AS hora, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM refunds WHERE cashier_id = 4 GROUP BY hora
SELECT strftime('%H', refunded_at) AS hora, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM refunds WHERE cashier_id = 4 GROUP BY hora
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM refunds WHERE cashier_id = 4 AND approved_by IS NULL
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS qtd, SUM(r.amount) AS total FROM refunds r JOIN cashiers c ON c.id = r.cashier_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY qtd DESC
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS qtd, SUM(r.amount) AS total FROM refunds r JOIN cashiers c ON c.id = r.cashier_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT t.store_id, t.register_no, COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN transactions t ON t.id = r.transaction_id GROUP BY t.store_id, t.register_no

SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS vendas, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS estornos, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.id), 3) AS razao FROM cashiers c JOIN transactions t ON t.cashier_id = c.id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.cashier_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY razao DESC
SELECT s.name, t.payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN transactions t ON t.id = r.transaction_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = t.store_id GROUP BY s.name, t.payment_method
SELECT s.name, SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r JOIN transactions t ON t.id = r.transaction_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = t.store_id GROUP BY s.name
